title: Benchmarking Educational LLMs with Analytics: A Case Study on Gender Bias in Feedback

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual manipulation of implicit cues (swapping gendered words in essays) and explicit cues (altering the student's name, pronouns, and school gender context in prompts), evaluated by measuring semantic drift in model-generated feedback using cosine and Euclidean distances of sentence embeddings, alongside qualitative analysis of linguistic and pedagogical differences.
